title: infra init: propose by standard then majority, deviations into unreviewed
objective: Adopt an existing estate without making its drift the target. `devbin infra init <domain>...` measures each domain's authoritative records and prints a profile to stdout in which a value reaches the target only when the RFC layer or the estate's own strict majority (above N=2, with every named domain in the denominator) determines it. Every other live value, and every read that could not be made, goes to `unreviewed:`, which `check` refuses to run past. Per hv's ruling of 2026-09-08 no vendor table ships: the only RFC-derived proposal is `p=none` on a mail-carrying domain with no DMARC record and no majority. The decisions the rulings left open are recorded in design.md, section `init AS BUILT`.
